name: Rac family small GTPase 1

function.text: RAC1 encodes ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 1. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and Rac protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 48 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Melanoma; Cutaneous Melanoma; Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
